description: This file defines ASN.1 utility structures and functions for encoding, decoding, and JSON serialization of protocol information elements, specifically for ASN.1 protocol extensions and IEs within the 'asn1' namespace.

classes.name: ie_field_value_item
classes.description: Template for ASN.1 field value items with get/set methods.

classes.name: ie_field_ext_item
classes.description: Template for ASN.1 extension field items with get/set methods.

classes.name: base_ie_field
classes.description: Base class for ASN.1 protocol information element fields, providing packing, unpacking, and JSON serialization.

classes.name: ie_value_item
classes.description: Template for ASN.1 IE value items.

classes.name: ie_ext_item
classes.description: Template for ASN.1 IE extension items.

classes.name: base_ie_container_item
classes.description: Base class for ASN.1 container items with packing, unpacking, and JSON serialization.

classes.name: empty_obj_set_item_c
classes.description: Represents an empty ASN.1 object set item with type enumeration and serialization methods.

classes.name: base_empty_obj_set
classes.description: Provides static methods for handling empty ASN.1 object set identifiers and properties.

methods.name: pack_ie_container_item
methods.description: Serializes an ASN.1 IE container item with given id, criticality, and value.

methods.name: ie_container_item_to_json
methods.description: Serializes an ASN.1 IE container item to JSON format.
